before.requirement: Reject "[0e]" specifically because strict mode disallows a missing exponent.
before.reason: The complete old number path has no strict-mode missing-exponent check; its strict handling here concerns leading zeroes.

after.requirement: With JSON_TOKENER_STRICT set, reject "[0e]" as an incomplete exponent.
after.reason: Strict mode bypasses permissive trimming and the added case specifies a number error; the harness has no flag-setting call.
